principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate disciplines.
Emotion First: Design for feeling, not trends.
Content is King: Direct the user's emotion like a film scene.
Zoom In: Use bold focus on details.
Contrast: Light vs Dark, Rough vs Smooth.

primary.name: Electric Indigo
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Active States, Key Brand Elements

headings.usage: All H1-H6, Landing Page Heros, Feature Titles

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI Labels, Inputs, Data Tables

rules: Overlines must be Uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs.
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-indigo-500 rounded-md shadow-sm

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full backgrounds. Use subtle mesh gradients in 'AI Magic' sections only.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for UI, shadow-xl for floating elements (modals, dropdowns).

landing_page.hero: Split layout. Left: Big Bold Value Prop + 'Generate for Free' CTA. Right: Interactive 'Before/After' slider or video mockup using the influencer images.
landing_page.features: Bento Grid layout highlighting 'Motion Preservation', 'Face Swap', '60s Limit', 'High Quality'.
landing_page.pricing: Three cards. 'Starter' (Standard), 'Pro' (Highlighted/Scale), 'Agency' (Minimal). Pro card should have a 'Most Popular' badge and a slight border glow (indigo-500/20).

dashboard.overview: Top: Credit Balance (Big Number). Middle: Quick Action 'New Reel'. Bottom: Recent Jobs Table.
dashboard.create_flow: Step-by-step wizard. Step 1: Upload Ref Video (Drag & Drop zone). Step 2: Upload Face (Circular preview). Step 3: Prompt (Text area with 'Magic' icon). Step 4: Review.
dashboard.job_card: Thumbnail on left, status badge (Processing/Done) on right. Hover to see 'Download' button.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Do NOT use center alignment for long text blocks.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
